cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Can I keep one plant on your windowsill? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Excellent. Sunlight is available to guests. Shall we discuss the other pot?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've agreed the principle. Now we're negotiating the size of its audience.

mechanism: A manages a windowsill arrangement by securing one plant, then uses the allowed sunlight to push for another while offering work that retains B consent.
confusable: D220 conceals a plan; this Drive argues from an already conceded principle to challenge the remaining limit.
comparison: Speech alternative expands attribution from one paragraph to the argument, rather than physical space.
seedUse: Plant seed gives a narrow concession; replace the audience-of-principle metaphor with a specific fair-treatment argument and shared work.
